destroyed:flood.recommendation: Deploy heavy rescue team, boat unit, and medical unit.

major-damage:flood.recommendation: Deploy boat-capable rescue team and establish an evacuation corridor.

destroyed:fire.recommendation: Deploy fire suppression, heavy rescue, and medical unit.

major-damage:fire.recommendation: Deploy fire suppression and structural assessment teams.

destroyed:structural.recommendation: Establish a safety perimeter and deploy heavy rescue plus structural engineers.

major-damage:structural.recommendation: Restrict access and deploy structural assessment and rescue teams.

minor-damage:unknown.recommendation: Schedule inspection and keep a response unit on standby.

no-damage:unknown.recommendation: Continue monitoring; no immediate rescue deployment is indicated.

default.recommendation: Perform a field assessment and keep a response unit on standby.
